corrections: Individual seven-seat 407GX shell, pilot/middle/aft glazing, chin windows, low skid gear and baggage hatch measured against the Bell drawing.
Raised and resectioned engine cowling, twin upward exhausts, tapered tail boom, stabilizer endplates, four-blade rotor and pitch links.
GX asymmetric coaming, two displays, two standby instruments, central pedestal, dual controls, overhead switches and seven beveled seats. Display layers corrected after close camera inspection.

Nose rebuilt: the sheet nose station of 3.28 m is a pitot tip, so the nose is now blunt and ends at 3.10 m, where it had been a wedge running to 3.28 m. The nose to stinger dimension stays 10.57 m through the pitot.
Windscreen now wraps down to the door post, as drawn and photographed. Opaque side panels had covered that glass.
Chin windows extended aft from station 2.65 m to about 2.3 m and moved low on the nose.
Side window height 0.69 m, was 0.55 m; drawn 0.73 m. Door seams and hinges moved to the drawn positions.
Forward fairing given its flat top at 2.35 m to station -0.66 m and the convex front, both up to 0.1 m low before. Boom depth at the stabilizer 0.41 m, was 0.34 m.
limitations: The dimension drawing is schematic; rotor azimuth and static blade droop differ from the modeled idle rotor.

Panel size comes from the GDU case and standby dials. The GX photograph crops the left panel edge, so the 0.74 m width is partly inferred, and panel height above the floor is judged from photographs at unsolved cameras.
Rear seating and upholstery are reconstructed from the manufacturer seating plan; equipment fits vary.
Avionics display graphics and labels are original simplified diagrams; this is not a systems trainer.
The side wall stays flat, so window tops stop at 1.60 m against 1.64 m drawn, and the rounded window corners and door tumblehome are not modeled.

independentDimensions.feature: aft blade tip height, low gear, as drawn

reviewNotes.visual: Front, side, top and panel overlays inspected; current lit three-quarter, operator, close cabin, wide cabin and four turntable views inspected. Internal cross-section slivers removed and display foreground layers repaired.
reviewNotes.heightNote: The model is 3.36 m tall at its aft blade tip. The Bell sheet draws that tip at 3.34 m on low gear and 3.5 to 3.6 m on high gear, so the widely quoted 3.56 m matches the high skid installation. The fin is 3.10 m, as printed. The EASA OEB fuselage height of 2.68 m was not reconciled with the sheet: the drawn cowling top is 2.37 m.

limitations: The dimension drawing is schematic; rotor azimuth and static blade droop differ from the modeled idle rotor.

controlReview.checks: Imported GLB control-point movement tested at positive and negative commands; all 20 aircraft pass. Cockpit pairs and all ten airplane exterior pairs visually inspected. Roll, pitch, rudder and declared pedal directions corrected; ailerons and full flap deployment corrected.
limitations: Checks cover existing bindings; Cherokee and Caravan pedal geometry is static.
Full control travel and flight response remain approximations unless independently dimensioned in the model reference notes.
This audit verifies movement; it does not upgrade legacy helicopter avionics or remove previously documented geometry limitations.

cockpitReview.method: Rays from the pilotEye through source.glb, seat view at the runtime camera (+Z, 60 degrees vertical), overlays of true-scale orthographic renders on the Bell side and front views, and a view from the angle of the N23986 photograph.
cockpitReview.proportions: Length, rotor, skid span, fin height and cabin width were already right. What read as off was shape, listed under reviewNotes corrections.
corrections: Panel moved to its own group scaled 0.62; layout and bindings unchanged.

Front seats, eye, cyclics, collectives, pedestal and pedals moved about 0.27 m forward: the 407 door and windscreen stand that far forward of the 206 stations, and the head now sits in the first door window. Seats dropped 0.04 m, aft-facing seats moved up behind them.
Pedestal narrowed to the 0.26 m of the GX photograph and raised to meet the panel foot. Floors and the aft seat row brought inside the shell.
